summary: Executed live frontend smoke/e2e checks against the public URL: loader, hero routing, required form validation, pricing calculator, rating modal, and admin login screen.

integration_issues.issue: Using the supplied credentials, clicking Sign in did not transition from /adevglobpik login to the dashboard after 3 seconds; the UI catches the Firebase error without displaying any error message, making the failure silent.
Both submit handlers catch all Firestore errors and still show success/close the modal. A denied/offline write can therefore be reported as successful to users.

action_items: Investigate Firebase Auth sign-in for the supplied admin account and expose a visible auth error instead of silently swallowing it.
Only show contact success/rating close after addDoc resolves; render a user-facing error on Firestore failure.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js globally swallows Firebase Auth and Firestore exceptions, so production integration failures are indistinguishable from successful operations.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no custom backend endpoints; architecture is direct Firebase SDK)
success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 executed flow groups passed; admin auth failed)

seed_data_creation: Attempted one rating submission named UI Test; client reported modal close but write outcome was not independently confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loader was tested at ~7.2s, public CTA/navigation/calculator/rating modal passed. Note generated nav IDs preserve label casing (nav-Pricing-link), and supplied admin credentials did not reach dashboard.
rca of the issue: Admin login handler catches signInWithEmailAndPassword errors with an empty catch and has no error state. The observed persistent login screen may be invalid/disabled Firebase credentials or Firebase Auth configuration; browser UI provides no diagnostic. Contact and rating handlers use the same empty-catch pattern and unconditionally report success/close.
